name: Japan Weekend Madrid
blurb: Spain's biggest Japanese pop-culture event, with anime voice actors, manga artists, musicians, VTubers and a major cosplay competition.

editions.evidence: Main site (japanweekend.com) events list: 'JAPAN WEEKEND 2027 MADRID - febrero'.

notes: The dedicated Madrid page itself has not been updated yet for 2027: it still shows its just-concluded 26-27 September 2026 edition (countdown at zero), including that edition's own guest list (Katsuyuki Konishi, May'n, Yoshitoshi ABe, etc.) and poster art, which is not reused here since it belongs to a different, past edition. Only the main site names a 2027 Madrid date, and only as a month ('febrero'), with no venue, tickets or guests yet, so those are left blank/none-yet rather than guessed.
